title: Database CSV — import + export for notion-database
description: CSV import + export companion for notion-database. CsvActions ships a dropdown w/ Export + Import items. CsvImportDialog parses a .csv file, lets the user map each column to an existing property / Title / skip / + New Property, then emits a single onImport callback containing {newProperties, rows} so the host writes through its own adapter (no useStore coupling). Computed types (formula, created_time, last_edited_time, unique_id) are recognised + never written from CSV. Pure / props-driven. Lifted from notion-page-clone (Nosion).

peers.reason: Reuses Database / Property / PropertyValue / PropertyType / SelectOption domain types from notion-database (which re-exports them from notion-shell).
